This first application has been filed by applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.464/2023 registered at Police Station Kshipra, District (Indore Rural),
Indore(M.P.) for offence punishable under Section (s) 363, 366A, 376(2)(n), 376(3) of IPC and 3/4 and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.

entities.text:

Indore(M.P.)
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in judicial custody since 10.11.2023.
As per the case of prosecution, grand father of the victim reported to P.S. Kshipra District Indore(M.P.) that his grand daughter aged around 15 years is missing since the night of 11.09.2023.
He suspects that some unknown person has enticed and taken his grand daughter.
On such allegation, P.S. Kshipra registered FIR at Crime No.464/2023 for offence punishable under Section 363 of IPC against unknown offender.
During investigation, victim was recovered from the possession of Abhishek(applicant) from Rajendra Nagar.
In her statement recorded under Sections 161 of Cr.P.C., victim alleged that Abhishek proposed to marry her and took her to Gujarat.
They stayed at the house of friend of Abhishek.

They had NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:779 2 MCRC-54996-2024 married at a Temple.
Abhishek had physical relations with her.
In her statement recorded u/S 164 of Cr.P.C., victim stated that she went to Gujarat with Abhishek at her own wish.
Abhishek does not compel her to go with him.
Abhishek has not done any misdeed with her.

On such statements, prosecution for offences punishable under Sections 366,
366A, 376(2)(n) and 376(3) of IPC and 3/4 and 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act was added.
Applicant - Abhishek was arrested on 10.11.2023.
He is in custody ever since.

On completion of investigation,
final report was submitted.

sentences.text: Learned Counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the matter under the pressure of family members of the victim.
No offence, as alleged, is committed by the applicant.
It is a case of teenage romance between two young adolescents.
Victim had left her parental home at her own will.
Victim had informed that she is major.
The determination of age during investigation is doubtful.
Learned counsel further submits that the applicant is aged around 20 years.
He is a labourer by profession.
There is no likelihood of absconsion leaving his family, home and profession.
No criminal antecedent is reported against the applicant.
There is no likelihood of tampering with the evidence by the applicant.
The trial would take time to complete.
Therefore, the applicant may be extended the benefit of bail.
Per contra, learned Counsel for the State opposes the bail application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the arguments advanced by both the parties and overall NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:779 3 MCRC-54996-2024 circumstances of the case, having regard to the young age of the applicant, without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, it is directed that applicant- Abhishek S/o Budhiya Mankar shall be released on bail in connection with the Crime as stated in para - 1 of this order, upon furnishing personal bond and surety bond of amount, as may be considered appropriate by the Trial Court/the Committal Court for compliance with conditions, as may be imposed by such Court, to secure presence of the applicant for the trial under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C., 1973/Section 480(3) of BNSS, 2023.
This order shall be effective till the end of trial.
However, in case of breach of any of the preconditions of bail, the concerned Court may consider, on merit, cancellation of bail without any impediment of this order.
The concerned Court shall get the conditions reproduced on the personal bond by the accused and on surety bond by the surety concerned.
If any of them is unable to write, the scribe shall certify that he had explained the conditions to the concerned accused or the surety.
C.C. as per rules

.
